title: NDP Gold ETL Configuration Schema
description: Schema for the gold_etl section of NDP stream configurations. Defines aggregates, features (lag, rolling, trend), and state transitions for Gold layer processing.

granularity.description: Time bucket granularity. Examples: '1 hour', '15 minutes', '1 day', '7 days'. Must match pattern: <number> <unit>.

metric.description: Aggregate metric type. mean=average, std=standard deviation, min/max=extremes, count=samples, p95/p99=percentiles, first/last=bucket boundaries.

stat.description: Feature statistic type for rolling windows. Limited to mean, std, min, max.

metrics.description: Metrics to compute for this field. Must have at least one metric.

exclude_from_default.description: If true, do not apply default_metrics to this field. Field will only get explicitly listed metrics.

aggregates.description: Aggregate configuration for Gold continuous aggregates. Defines time buckets and metrics per field.

granularities.description: Time bucket sizes for aggregation. Each granularity generates a separate continuous aggregate.

default_metrics.description: Default metrics applied to all numeric fields unless overridden or excluded.

fields.description: Per-field metric configuration. Keys are field names from the stream.

lag_features.description: Lag feature configuration for ML training. Creates lagged versions of fields for time-series analysis.

lags_hours.description: Lag offsets in hours. Example: [1, 6, 24] creates field_lag_1h, field_lag_6h, field_lag_24h.

fields.description: Fields to compute lags for. If empty, applies to all numeric fields.

rolling_features.description: Rolling window statistics for ML training. Computes stats over sliding windows.

windows.description: Rolling window sizes. Example: ['4 hours', '24 hours'] creates rolling_mean_4h, rolling_mean_24h.

stats.description: Statistics to compute over rolling windows.

fields.description: Fields to compute rolling stats for. If empty, applies to all numeric fields.

trend_features.description: Trend calculation for ML training. Computes simple slope approximation over a window.

window.description: Window for trend calculation. Example: '4 hours' computes (last - first) / 4.0.

fields.description: Fields to compute trends for. Required when enabled.

features.description: Feature engineering configuration for ML training data.

transitions.description: State transition tracking for state_event streams. Extracts state changes and durations.

enabled.description: Whether transition tracking is enabled. Only valid for state_event streams.

state_field.description: Field containing the state value to track transitions on.

entity_field.description: Field identifying the entity whose state is being tracked.

track_duration.description: Whether to track duration in previous state before transition.

include_in_alignment.description: Whether to include transitions in the domain aligned view.

gold_etl.description: Gold layer ETL configuration for a stream. Defines aggregates, features, and transitions.

enabled.description: Enable Gold layer processing for this stream.

description.description: Human-readable description of the Gold transformation.
